title: Personal Loans Due-Day Change Limits by Grade
content:
These figures limit when and how often the monthly due day of a Personal Loans loan can be moved.

## Limits by grade

| | Grade A | Grade B | Grade C | Grade D | Grade E | Grade F | Grade G |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Installments paid since funding before a change | 3 | 3 | 3 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 |
| Changes in any rolling 12 months | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Changes over the life of the loan | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 |
| Most days the first new due date may fall after the current next due date | 20 | 20 | 20 | 20 | 20 | 20 | 20 |
| Request lead time before the current next due date, calendar days | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 |

## Definitions

- **Installments paid since funding**: scheduled installments that must have been paid since funding before the due day may be changed (integer).
- **Changes per 12 months**: due-date changes allowed per loan in any rolling 12 months (integer).
- **Changes per loan**: due-date changes allowed over the life of a loan (integer).
- **Maximum shift**: most calendar days the first due date under the new due day may fall after the current next due date.
- **Request lead time**: calendar days before the current next due date by which a due-date change must be requested.

## Point of reading

Only the installments-paid figure differs by grade: 3 in Grades A, B and C and 6 in Grades D, E, F and G.
